content_zh:
第54章 没那么简单-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

存书签

下一章

花无非愿意和妖族和好绝对不是他的本意，看起来更像是被人胁迫而为，只是不知道什么样的人有这么大的本事能够威胁到花无非。

虽然花无非同样也在笑，但是寒月乔却发现花无非的笑容完全是强行挤出来的，简直比哭还要难看，如此一来寒月乔就更加可以肯定自己的猜测了。

寒月乔听到北堂夜泫这么说脸上的笑容不禁更加灿烂起来，与此同时也替寒飞飞感到一阵同情，还好寒飞飞没有听到北堂夜泫这番话，否则寒飞飞肯定要伤心死了。

“呀！这是什么！是黑碧玺吗！”亚尔丶释先让机器放在台面上，也不着急取走，这时候在靳叔的旧展架和柜台前后转悠寻觅，突然发现了一些名被唤作黑碧玺的宝石，当即就问。

“好的，我知道了。我这就去办。”那黑蝎会的三当家也知道这件事情非常的严重，没有犹豫，那黑蝎会的三当家，便是直接的离开了这里。

天妙上人脸色一沉，知道邪皇随时就会赶来。天妙上人也露出紧张，毕竟邪皇的实力在那。如今就算卫鼎天半步武道道主，但依旧无法抗衡神秘而强大的邪皇。

如果不是因为和莫爸爸的关系太过恶劣了，或许她根本不会选择求证这件事情。

不过现在也好，大家都想着要坐收渔翁之利了，除了看热闹，应该就不会上前了吧？

但是谈判代表们虽然都感到了其中的阴谋味道，却不敢当场提出质疑，因为在船上被关了两天之后，他们此时最希望的就是安然脱身，而不是得罪面前这位脾气暴躁的海军司令。

雷元一经撷取出来，带有狂暴的雷芒，登时把他轰击得外焦里嫩，血肉焦黑，有如万针攒刺。

姬添兴站在最高处准备号令全军，所有人都屏息凝神准备迎接急行军的洗礼。

突然，暴雨加大降雨量，他站在雨中看着前面已经开始决口的道路，紧忙抓起一片草盖，朝前方奔跑过去。

Hua Wufei's willingness to reconcile with the demon clan was definitely not his intention. It seemed more like he was coerced into doing so, but he didn't know what kind of person could threaten Hua Wufei with such great ability.

Although Hua Wufei was also smiling, Han Yue Qiao found that Hua Wu Fei's smile was completely forced out and was even uglier than crying. In this way, Han Yue Qiao was even more sure of her guess.

When Han Yueqiao heard what Beitang Yexun said, the smile on her face couldn't help but become brighter. At the same time, she felt a pang of sympathy for Han Feifei. Fortunately, Han Feifei didn't hear Beitang Yexun's words, otherwise Han Feifei would have been heartbroken to death.

"Ah! What is this! Is it a black tourmaline!" Yaer and Shi first put the machine on the countertop and were not in a hurry to take it away. At this time, they were wandering around Uncle Jin's old display racks and counters, and suddenly found some gems called black tourmalines, and asked immediately.

"Okay, I understand. I'll take care of it right now." The third leader of the Black Scorpion Club also knew that this matter was very serious, and without hesitation, the third leader of the Black Scorpion Club left here directly.

Master Tianmiao's face darkened, knowing that the Evil Emperor would arrive at any moment.Master Tianmiao also showed nervousness, after all, the evil emperor's strength was there.Now even though Wei Dingtian is half a martial arts master, he is still unable to compete with the mysterious and powerful Evil Emperor.

If it weren't for the bad relationship with Father Mo, maybe she wouldn't choose to verify this matter at all.

But now, everyone is thinking about reaping the benefits. Apart from watching the fun, they probably won’t come forward, right?

However, although the negotiators all felt the smell of conspiracy, they did not dare to question it on the spot, because after being detained on the ship for two days, what they wanted most at this time was to escape safely instead of offending the grumpy naval commander in front of them.

As soon as Lei Yuan was taken out, the violent thunder light blasted him until he was scorched on the outside and tender on the inside, and his flesh and blood were burnt black, like thousands of needles pricking him.

Ji Tianxing stood at the top and prepared to give orders to the entire army. Everyone held their breath and prepared for the baptism of the rapid march.

Suddenly, the heavy rain increased the amount of rainfall. He stood in the rain and looked at the road ahead that had begun to burst. He quickly grabbed a piece of grass and ran forward.
